title: Island Rumours & Mapping
intro: What each tavern rumour actually decodes to — the island it points at, its remnant/mod gimmick, the layout, and whether it's worth running. Ratings run S+ (drop everything) down to F (skip). Several "old layout" islands keep infinite revives, which is great for grinding remnants. ⚠️ Crowd-sourced from the community; map names and ratings shift between patches, so treat this as a starting read and verify in-game.

sections.heading: Island Rumours
sections.blurb: Match the rumour phrase to its island. Sorted best-to-worst by community rating. The Notes column carries the layout and remnant gimmick.

rows: Unique expedition. No enemies — a chain explosion adds rune sockets to one huge singular remnant. Top-tier.
Great general monster-buffing remnants. Old layout, so infinite revives.
Decent open layout. Oil-derrick remnants that do big explodey damage.
Good open layout. Kin-totem remnants for rarer items; boss arena holds two Rogue Exiles.
Bad layout. Remnants give an all-resistance amulet.
Many-stairs layout. Explode three leylines to activate a beacon → reveals a nearby Expedition logbook area, inheriting the sagas used to spawn the ruins.
Openish layout. Increased-exp remnants; 30% chance to summon Beyond monsters on the beach; Arohangui's Hoard chests drop a lot of currency. Old layout, infinite respawns.
Azmeri-spirits layout. Bad remnants, good layout.
Good open layout, strongbox-gimmick map, gold-chest remnant, old layout (infinite revives) — but rated a skip.

sections.heading: Unique Maps
sections.blurb: Rumours that resolve to a unique map instead of a standard island.

sections.heading: Boss Rumours
sections.blurb: Boss-island rumours, the island they spawn on, and which pinnacle boss waits there.

sections.heading: Sagas
sections.blurb: Sagas used to spawn content. Aldur's buffs Expeditions but is a gamble; the boss sagas drop a guaranteed boss node.
sections.note: Boss sagas inherited into Exhumed Ruins (the "Unknown Ruins" rumour) carry over to the revealed Expedition logbook area.
